visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a red spatula scooping yellowish bamboo shoot slices and dark green mustard greens into a blue and white patterned ceramic bowl. A text overlay reads '客家油燜筍' at the top against a bright, well-lit kitchen background. (2) Hands wearing transparent plastic gloves handle pale pink chicken carcasses in a clear glass bowl filled with water, cleaning them thoroughly. The lighting is bright and even. (3) A side view shows the chef's hands cutting dark brown pickled mustard greens (fu cai) into small sections on a light wood cutting board. (4) The gloved hands tear long pale yellow bamboo shoot stalks (gui zhu sun) and then slice them into bite-sized rectangular pieces on the same wooden board. (5) Inside a black speckled non-stick pan, ingredients are added sequentially: clear sesame oil from a small glass bowl, whole garlic cloves, green onion segments, and the chopped mustard greens. A red spatula stirs the mixture. (6) Sliced bamboo shoots are added to the pan from a glass bowl, followed by white granulated sugar, sliced red chili, and dark brown soy sauce poured directly from a bottle. (7) Clear yellow chicken broth is poured into the pan, followed by the cleaned chicken carcasses and fresh green onion segments. The mixture begins to steam visibly. (8) The scene transitions to the food inside a stainless steel electric cooker pot. Dark brown vinegar is poured into the pot from a measuring cup. (9) The final shot shows a close-up of black chopsticks picking up a piece of glistening bamboo shoot and a strand of mustard green, showcasing the oily and tender texture of the finished dish.
